Rollback / contingency triggers (short):
- If post-cutover latency > 400ms p50 and error rate > 1% for 15 consecutive minutes -> initiate rollback A (traffic split back to prior endpoint + disable dedicated cache)
- If inference outputs show >5% QA regression on the sanity prompt set after token 200 -> fallback to smaller-compatible model and throttle new sessions
- If authorization failures >0.5% after cutover -> revert SSO routing and execute emergency token reset (Ben)

- Pre-cutover dry run (traffic split + smoke): Nov 28 10:00 PT (Ops reps)
